title: The per-task word bound conflicts with the approved line at small held-task counts
detail: Needs decision; kind: design. A First Officer using the supported startup/idle tasks command with one held task reads 17 added words, against amendment 2 maximum 3*1+6=9. Current fourteen tasks pass 32/48. The approved instruction also says the program does not change, so validation cannot choose new wording or restrict the formula to the current dataset. This is a design-bound conflict, not a demonstrated held-task classification failure.
fix: FO disposition is required: decide whether amendment 2 is a current-dataset measurement or a bound across supported held-task counts; any scope or wording change follows the existing amendment/feedback route.
released_user_and_workflow: FO startup and idle use pr_watch.py tasks; the accepted design explicitly considers a sibling adopter with one held task.
observable_harm: One-task line is eight words over the stated nine-word maximum; two and three tasks also exceed the formula.
boundary: captain-ruling[2026-11-12] amendment 2: every held task permits three added words plus six fixed words.
verdict_effect: REJECTED pending FO disposition; do not silently repair or broaden the bound.
